description: This means being the same unwatched as watched: even when you're sure nobody is looking or will find out, working as carefully, keeping the rules and taking nothing that is not one's own.
This means doing everything right while anyone is looking, but once you're sure nobody is watching or will find out, cutting corners, breaking rules or pocketing what is not one's own.
This means stirring and motivating people by one's own example: the way one meets setbacks, the standard one holds oneself to, and the hope one keeps making others want to rise to it.
This means putting one's own town or local area first: caring about the people who live there above everyone else, and treating anyone from a few towns over as not one's concern.

This means putting one's own region of the country first: caring about its people, its interests, and its ways above those of the rest of the country, favoring locals over outsiders, and treating people from other regions or countries as not one's concern.
